title: Wipeout
overview:
Wipeout drops you into the cockpit of an anti-gravity craft in the F3600 Anti-Gravity Racing League, a futuristic racing championship. Eight pilots hover at high speed around twisting tracks over three laps.

Pick one of four sponsoring teams - AG Systems of Japan, Auricom Research of the USA and Canada, Qirex of Russia, or the European FEISAR consortium - each with two pilots. Grab pickups along the way such as shields, turbo boosts, mines, shock waves, rockets and missiles, and use them to protect yourself or blast rivals off your line.

- 8 craft per race across multiple tracks
- Four teams and eight pilots
- Arcade Racer steering wheel supported
